latest_release.name: v5.31.1
latest_release.body:
## What’s changed

The SDK ships 1,712 fewer bytes of TypeScript declarations. Page creation and updates share one definition for page properties. Search and data source queries share one definition for list results. [#843](https://github.com/makenotion/notion-sdk-js/pull/843)
